title: 2014: Advanced fuzzing, SOAP scanning, and Access Control
description: Student Hall of Fame entries for 2014 Summer GSoC: Advanced fuzzing, SOAP scanning, and Advanced Access Control testing

chapters.title: Advanced fuzzing
chapters.text: The Hall of Fame lists Sebastian Schulze for Advanced fuzzing (2014 Summer GSoC). The commit "Core packages for multi-fuzzing." is dated 2014-06-04.

chapters.title: SOAP scanning
chapters.text: The Hall of Fame lists Alberto Verza for SOAP scanning (2014 Summer GSoC). The commit "WSDL file import Add-On." is dated 2014-04-30. Blog post: https://www.zaproxy.org/blog/2014-09-03-alberto-s-gsoc-2014-project-for-zap-soap-scanner-add-on/

chapters.title: Advanced Access Control testing
chapters.text: The Hall of Fame lists Cosmin Stefan for Advanced Access Control testing (2014 Summer GSoC). The commit "Core packages for multi-fuzzing." is dated 2014-06-04.
